# 100.00 USD arrives in the USD bank, booked against a CAD receivable.
#
# On the book fx_usd_invoice_cad_income.txt builds, INV-USD-001 posts to
# `Assets:Accounts Receivable USD`. This money was booked to a second
# receivable, kept in CAD, which that invoice does not post to. The split
# there is in no lot.
#
# What this fixture produces: the CAD receivable, and one CAD-quoted
# transaction whose other side is on it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable CAD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-25 * "Money in against another receivable"
	guid: "d0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "e1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.39"
		value: "139.00"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable CAD -139.00 CAD
		guid: "f2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-139.00"
